skills.summary: See exactly where your Claude spend goes, and which of it you could have avoided.
skills.description: Screen your Claude Code token usage: where it went, which tasks and tools consumed it, and where it is avoidable. Local transcripts only - no network.
highlights: Splits spend into input, output, cache-write and cache-read, priced and ranked
Groups every turn under the prompt that started it, so cost maps to work
Seven detectors that each name a saving with the evidence behind it
skills.requires: python3 (already on macOS and Linux). Reads ~/.claude/projects only. No network.
skills.notes: Reads Claude Code's local transcripts, so it runs in the CLI only. There is nothing for it to read inside the Desktop or web sandbox.

skills.name: token-screener
skills.description: Analyze Claude Code token usage from local transcripts - total spend, which tasks and tools consumed it, and where it is avoidable. Use when the user asks about token usage, cost, or spend ("how many tokens am I using", "what am I spending", "token report", "why is this so expensive", "how do I use fewer tokens", "am I wasting tokens", "audit my usage"), or invokes /token-screener.

skills.summary: What an order actually earns once GST, shipping, payment fees and COD returns are taken out.
skills.description: Work out what a D2C order actually earns after GST, product cost, packing, shipping, payment fees, COD returns and marketing: CM1/CM2/CM3, max CAC, breakeven ROAS and the discount floor.
highlights: CM1, CM2 and CM3 per order, with GST stripped out of revenue where it belongs
Models COD and prepaid separately, then blends them - including what RTO costs you
Gives you the most you can pay per order, the breakeven ROAS, and the discount floor
skills.requires: Nothing. Runs on the figures you give it, or a CSV of your catalogue.
skills.notes: Estimates from the numbers you supply, not accounts. GST input credit on costs is not modelled, and returns are treated as stock recovered with freight lost.
